reason: Pre-existing hand-rolled compositions of the peaks-loop runtime layout. This is a RATCHET, not a justification: the rule going forward is that the ONLY composition site is the workspace-runtime package (defaultStateRoot -> sessionRuntimeDir), and this list may only shrink. Every entry is machine-checked to still contain a composition (an inert entry fails), so migrating a file out of this list is the way it shrinks. After the 2026-11-05 runtime-composition sweep the list is exactly the TWO files that cannot be expressed through the seam, and both for the same reason: each derives a PROJECT-RELATIVE path, takes no projectRoot, and is pure and never-throwing, so defaultStateRoot (which needs a root) cannot express it — src/services/prd/gate-evidence-derivation.ts builds `.peaks/_runtime/<sid>/...` for a caller to join onto its own root, and src/services/prd/handoff-path-resolution.ts returns the same shape for callers to resolve. Not an exemption for convenience: a project-relative path is a different object from a state root, and routing these through the seam would force a root parameter neither has.
